title: Builder Rate Card — New Home Builder Warranties Enrollment Fees and Deadlines
content:
This rate card sets, for each program of Bridgewell's New Home Builder Warranties, the enrollment fee a registered builder is billed for each home and the two deadlines that apply to the builder: the enrollment window after the sale closes and the payment period after enrollment. The homeowner pays nothing for the warranty.

## Rates and deadlines by program

| Program | Fee per 1,000 dollars of final sale price | Minimum fee per home | Enrollment window after closing | Payment period after enrollment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Structural-Only Ten-Year Warranty | 1.75 USD | 295.00 USD | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty | 2.75 USD | 450.00 USD | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty with Appliances | 3.25 USD | 525.00 USD | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Attached Home Warranty | 2.95 USD | 475.00 USD | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty with Systems Extension | 3.40 USD | 560.00 USD | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days |
| Bridgewell 2-4-10 Premier Builder Warranty | 4.10 USD | 650.00 USD | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days |

## Notes to the rate card

- The rate column is applied to the final sale price shown on the closing statement, at the program's rate for each 1,000 dollars of that price; the minimum column is the least fee billed for any one home under the program.
- The enrollment window is counted in calendar days from the closing date; the payment period is counted in calendar days from the date the builder enrolled the home.
- The two deadlines are the same, 30 calendar days each, under every program.

## Rate card at a glance

**Which program carries the lowest rate and minimum?** The Bridgewell Structural-Only Ten-Year Warranty, at 1.75 USD per 1,000 dollars and a 295.00 USD minimum.

**Which carries the highest?** The Bridgewell 2-4-10 Premier Builder Warranty, at 4.10 USD per 1,000 dollars and a 650.00 USD minimum.
